name: line-oa-mcp-ultimate
description: Operate one or many LINE Official Accounts from any AI agent — through natural language, no code. Send broadcasts, design Flex messages and tappable Rich Messages, build Thai-ready rich menus (Rich Menu Studio), manage audiences, coupons, and insights. New in 2.2: attach a picture and say send — it reaches your customers with ZERO hosting setup, auto-resized to every size LINE needs and verified deliverable before the tool ever says success (never a dead end, even on locked-down networks). Hardened in 2.2.1: server (HTTP) mode is now rock-solid with real AI agents, and hosted images cache so a broadcast to thousands barely touches your machine. LINE Shopping (MyShop, opt-in): products, stock, orders, parcel labels, settlements, checkout links. 37 messaging + 14 shopping tools, agency-ready multi-OA. Works with Claude Cowork, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT desktop, and any MCP-compatible host.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
